description: This file defines a PHP class 'Jira' within the namespace 'JiraApi' that acts as a client for interacting with Jira's REST API. It includes methods for user management, issue handling, project info, and other Jira API functionalities.

classes.name: Jira
classes.description: A PHP class providing methods to interact with Jira's REST API, including user, issue, project, and metadata operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Jira client with configuration parameters and sets up the request object.

methods.name: configCheck
methods.description: Validates that essential configuration parameters like host, username, and password are set.

methods.name: testLogin
methods.description: Tests the login credentials by attempting to retrieve the current user.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves user information by username.

methods.name: getUserByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves user information by email.

methods.name: getMyself
methods.description: Retrieves information about the current authenticated user.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Fetches all possible statuses from Jira.

methods.name: getTransitions
methods.description: Retrieves available transitions for a specific issue.

methods.name: getChangelog
methods.description: Fetches changelog history for an issue, optionally as text.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Retrieves comments for an issue.

methods.name: queryIssue
methods.description: Performs a JQL query to search issues.

methods.name: createIssue
methods.description: Creates a new Jira issue with specified fields.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Adds an attachment to an issue.

methods.name: updateIssue
methods.description: Updates an existing issue with new fields.

methods.name: transitionIssue
methods.description: Transitions an issue to a new status.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Adds a comment to an issue.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific issue.

methods.name: checkUserPermissionsForProject
methods.description: Checks if a user has specific permissions for a project.

methods.name: getIssueTypes
methods.description: Fetches available issue types.

methods.name: getPriorities
methods.description: Fetches available priorities.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Retrieves versions for a project.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Retrieves components for a project.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Fetches project details by project key.

methods.name: getCreateIssueFields
methods.description: Retrieves issue creation metadata including fields for specified projects.

methods.name: getCreateIssueMetadata
methods.description: Fetches metadata for creating issues, optionally filtered by project keys.
